summary: Clean on the SEC dimension. The table-valued-function path has no reachable memory-safety hazard from untrusted input: the only externally-influenced values (hidden-arg literals from the SQL query) flow solely into sqlite3_value_int64/double and then to fn as numbers, never indexing a buffer; the scratch buffer for UTF-32->UTF-8 is sized to (max U-column width + 1) and allocated whenever any U column exists, which covers each per-column requirement of width+1 bytes; result_text/result_blob lengths come from the fixed column width trimmed by _nul_trimmed_len (trailing-only, interior NUL preserved, no truncation/disclosure); and the cell address is bounded by the xEof rowid<n_rows guard. Array data/dtype come from the user's fn under a documented trusted-by-contract producer relationship. No SQL injection surface (no untrusted interpolation), no format strings, no library-path loading in this module.
